title: Working Out the Tier a Personal Checking Relationship Supports
content:
The tier a Personal Checking relationship supports is the highest whose relationship maintenance threshold the relationship balance reaches: at or above the private client threshold of 250000.00 the account belongs on Private Client Checking, at or above the premier threshold of 25000.00 on Premier Checking, at or above the interest threshold of 15000.00 on Interest Checking, and below that on Everyday Checking.

The relationship balance is put together from four components.

1. **The deposit component** is half, that is 0.5, of the owner's premier money market balance.
2. **The certificate component** is nothing at all, that is 0.00 of the owner's certificate principal.
3. **The checking component.** The account's own deposits less its paid items is the total of every deposit posted to the account less the total of every paid item posted to it, rounded half-up to the cent. The checking component is the account's own deposits less its paid items where that stands above zero and nothing where it does not.
4. **The card component** is the total of the card payments the owner has made in the last twelve months, taken at the card relationship share of 0.1 and rounded half-up to the cent.

The four components are put together by taking the largest single component of the deposit, certificate and checking components alone.

**Worked example on hypothetical inputs.** An owner holds a premier money market balance of 30000.00 and certificate principal of 40000.00, the checking account's deposits come to 9400.00 against paid items of 7000.00, and card payments in the last twelve months come to 8000.00.

| Component | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Deposit component | 15000.00 |
| Certificate component | 0.00 |
| The account's own deposits less its paid items | 2400.00 |
| Checking component | 2400.00 |
| Card component | 800.00 |
| Largest of the deposit, certificate and checking components | 15000.00 |
| Relationship balance | 15000.00 |
| Tier the relationship supports | Interest Checking |

The relationship balance of 15000.00 sits at the interest threshold and not at the premier threshold, and a figure at a threshold reaches it, so the account belongs on Interest Checking. The card component is worked out but does not enter the largest-single-component figure.
